name: direct_route
title: The direct YUME route
summary: An application's traffic enters yume, crosses the YUME carrier to yumed, and yumed opens the connection to the destination.

nodes.title: Application
nodes.note: Reaches yume through its SOCKS5 listener, a local forward or the managed TUN device, or embeds YUME through the C ABI.

nodes.title: yume
nodes.note: Holds one authenticated YTP/1 session to the server and carries each connection or packet flow as a stream inside it.

nodes.title: yumed
nodes.note: Decrypts the session, checks that the client may use the service and reach the destination, and opens the outbound socket. It sees what it forwards.

nodes.title: Destination
nodes.note: Gets an ordinary connection from the server, and sees the application's own traffic, such as its TLS.
